objects.description: [OSX_OCEANLOTUS.D](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0352) scrambles and encrypts data using AES256 before sending it to the C2 server.(Citation: TrendMicro MacOS April 2018)(Citation: Trend Micro MacOS Backdoor November 2020)
